sources.title: Vikings' Brian O'Neill: I wish I took a shot at Javon Bullard after his hit on Kyler Murray
sources.description: Packers safety Javon Bullard got a 15-yard penalty for the hit that knocked Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray out of Sunday's game.
